lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: irrationality of √2 and transfer of root reasoning
lessonRef.title: Knowing that √2 is irrational, and consolidating root reasoning

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Use these examples as the model for the work below.

items.prompt: Classify √49 and √50 as rational or irrational.

steps: 49 is a perfect square: 7² = 49, so √49 = 7, which is the ratio 7/1. It is rational.
50 is not a perfect square: 7² = 49 and 8² = 64, so √50 lies strictly between 7 and 8.
A square root of a whole number that is not a perfect square cannot be written as a ratio of two integers, so √50 is irrational.

items.prompt: A square has area 18 square units. Give its exact side length and classify it.

steps: A side s satisfies s² = 18, and a length is positive, so s = √18.
18 is not a perfect square: 16 < 18 < 25, so √18 lies strictly between 4 and 5.
√18 is irrational. A rounded value such as 4.24 is an approximation, not the exact length.

items.prompt: Which statement about the decimal expansion of √2 is correct?
choices: It terminates after several digits
It repeats a fixed block of digits forever

items.prompt: Which single fact, if someone found it, would show that √2 is NOT irrational?
choices: Whole numbers a and b, with b ≠ 0, satisfying (a/b)² = 2
A decimal approximation of √2 accurate to twenty places
A calculation showing 1.41² is close to 2
An argument showing √2 lies between 1 and 2

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Work these with no support. Show enough that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: Is √2 rational or irrational, and why?
choices: Rational — every square root can be written as a fraction
Irrational — 2 is not a perfect square, so √2 cannot be written as a ratio of two integers
Rational — √2 is 1.414
Irrational — √2 is greater than 1

items.prompt: Is √49 rational or irrational, and why?
choices: Irrational — it is written with a radical symbol
Rational — 49 is a perfect square, so √49 = 7 = 7/1
Irrational — 7 is an odd number
Rational — 49 is an odd number
